citation_removal_test: If the incident citation is removed, the item must not remain a generic injunction true of any IAM estate.

items.item: Treat IdP success and edge release as separate commits; require acknowledgment-before-commit or compensating rollback.
Do not key device caps on randomized MACs; use stable bindings and remediation UX.
Require atomic single-use consume for OIDC state or nonce; set TTL at least RTT; do not rely on JWT expiry alone.
Document two session planes; never skip edge re-authorization because SSO is warm.
Size federation timeouts for worst-site WAN, not LAN HA assumptions; plan degrade messaging.
Validate sticky routing and shared session stores across sites; expect re-authentication windows on failover.
Treat IdP cluster coherence as an authentication SLO; quorum runbooks; no dual-writer under partition.
Set gateway buffers at least 2x maximum assertion size; alert on truncation and idle kills.
Prefer authenticator-first MFA; treat SMS/PSTN as fallback only; non-stranding paths.
Run a dual-IdP equivalence checklist before cutover: token shape, claims, lifetimes.
